messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: Transition to Cross-Functional Pods & Performance Review Calibration

Team —

Following our leadership sync last week, I attached a working proposal to move from our current product-aligned pods to cross-functional pods for inference runtime, model ops, and platform services. The goals are: reduce handoffs, speed experimentation, and create clearer owner accountability for end-to-end customer SLAs.

Key asks in this email:
- High-level feedback on pod boundaries and owner assignment (see pod-mapping-v2.xlsx).
- Agreement on a timeline for performance-review calibration to avoid unfair rating shifts during the transition.
- Sign-off for confidential HR coordination to run role-scope changes and potential title adjustments (HR will need to be looped; we propose a private calibration session with HR Ops next week).

Short summary of proposed pods (row 1 of the spreadsheet):
- Inference Runtime Pod — serving runtime, kernel selection, latency SLOs.
- Model Lifecycle Pod — model onboarding, quantization profiles, rollouts.
- Platform Services Pod — observability, routing, billing attribution.

I've highlighted 7 roles that would change direct manager in the sheet; those are flagged for an HR sensitivity path and will require private 1:1 outreach before any public comms. Samantha from Greenfield will help with calibrated messaging and the review grid.

Please reply with top 3 concerns by EOD Thursday so we can fold comments into the exec summary.

Thanks,
Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
VP, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Proposal: Transition to Cross-Functional Pods & Performance Review Calibration

Marcus —

Thanks for the packet and the clear asks. I scanned pod-mapping-v2 and the boundaries look reasonable. A couple of immediate concerns:

1) Critical ICs in the runtime team have upcoming promotion cycles in Jan; we need to avoid any ambiguity that would invalidate those calibrations. Can HR provide a freeze window for promotions during the first two weeks of January?

2) Customer-facing SLAs: if we reassign ownership mid-quarter, we should include a 30-day overlap and a service owner contact list. Please add a column for SLA contacts in the spreadsheet.

3) Comms cadence: prefer a staged approach — private 1:1s for impacted people, then team-level announcement, then town hall. The comm-plan-draft looks fine but needs a more explicit timeline.

I will schedule 30 minutes with HR Ops and Samantha to walk through the calibration grid.

Laura
Director, People & Programs
Redwood Inference

Marcus + team —

Appreciate the draft. A few operational notes from my side as EM for Platform Services: 

- Resource contention: the model lifecycle work will spike in Q1 (two large on-call-straddling rollouts). We should model capacity and consider temporary backfills rather than shifting permanent headcount at launch.
- Reporting lines: avoid dual direct reporting for ICs where possible. If we must have matrixed influence, identity a single official manager for performance reviews to keep calibration simple.
- Performance review impact: propose the following clause in comms to reassure folks: "For the upcoming review cycle, performance ratings will be calibrated to reflect role changes and new reporting lines; no one will be penalized for transition-related disruption." Please let People sign off on the wording before it goes live.

Happy to take the lead on the overlap plan and to draft updated role descriptions for the 7 impacted roles.

— Soojin
Engineering Manager, Platform Services
Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Thanks for including Greenfield. A few suggestions from our org-change playbook based on similar transitions: 

1) Pre-announce to impacted ICs with a one-pager and manager talking points at least 72 hours before any public message.
2) Run an independent calibration session with People Ops + the new managers using the attached calibration-matrix.pdf. Use anonymized submissions in the first run to reduce anchoring.
3) Consider a 60-day “review goodwill” window where any performance improvement plans paused if the change materially affects role scope.

I can join the HR Ops meeting Friday to walk through the matrix. Also attaching a short script for private 1:1s.

Samantha
Principal Consultant, Greenfield Consulting
